title: How the current Town Board was elected
intro: How many actual votes put each current Riverhead Town Board member in office — and how that compares to the town's total population and its registered voters. A low share isn't an accusation; it's the normal reality of low-turnout local elections, and a useful reminder of how few votes decide who controls the Town's budget.

denominators.populationSource: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census — Town of Riverhead population 35,902.
denominators.registeredVotersSource: Suffolk County Board of Elections, active registered voters in the Town of Riverhead as of the November 2025 election (~24,217).

note: Vote counts are the winning candidate's own total, from the Suffolk County Board of Elections' final certified results (including the 2025 supervisor recount). The registered-voter denominator is the November 2025 figure; the 2023 winners are compared against it as an approximate reference, since the exact 2023 roll differed slightly. Percentages are the winner's votes divided by each denominator — not a turnout rate. The 2026 supervisor results shown under Recent general elections are the Board of Elections' unofficial election-night tally and have not been certified.

members.name: Jerome (Jerry) Halpin
members.result: Defeated incumbent Tim Hubbard 3,958 to 3,921 — a 37-vote margin that held through a full manual recount. On November 3, 2026 he won a full two-year term, 6,779 to 6,152 over Councilman Kenneth Rothwell, in unofficial Board of Elections results that are not yet certified.

members.name: Robert "Bob" Kern
members.result: Re-elected to a three-year term; his 3,958 votes were the highest total in any Riverhead race that year.

members.name: Kenneth Rothwell
members.result: Re-elected to a three-year term, defeating Democrat Mark Woolley 3,882 to 3,824 — a 58-vote margin. He ran for Supervisor on November 3, 2026 and trailed 6,779 to 6,152 in unofficial results (not yet certified); his Council seat is unaffected and runs through December 31, 2028.

members.name: Joann Waski
members.result: Won one of two open council seats with 4,875 votes (29.2%) in a four-way race.

members.name: Denise Merrifield
members.result: Top vote-getter for the two open council seats with 4,992 votes (29.9%) in a four-way race.

priorElections.turnoutNote: 12,938 votes counted in the supervisor race, including 7 write-in votes, from all 22 election districts' in-person results. Absentee and affidavit ballots may still change these totals.

races.note: Jerry Halpin leads by 627 votes (52.40% to 47.55%); seven write-in votes were also reported. Halpin: Democratic/Taxpayers First, 6,779. Rothwell: Republican/Conservative, 6,152.

priorElections.turnoutNote: 7,879 of 24,429 registered voters cast a ballot in the supervisor race (32.3%) — an even lower turnout than the prior cycles.

races.note: Jerry Halpin flipped the seat for the Democrats by 37 votes, confirmed on a full manual recount.

priorElections.turnoutNote: 9,142 of 23,133 registered voters cast a ballot in the supervisor race (39.5%).

races.note: Current members Kenneth Rothwell and Robert Kern first won their council seats here.

priorElections.turnoutNote: 8,587 of 21,798 registered voters cast a ballot in the supervisor race (39.4%).

races.note: Timothy Hubbard — later supervisor, defeated in 2025 — first won a council seat here.

priorElections.turnoutNote: 9,011 of 21,833 registered voters cast a ballot in the supervisor race (41.3%).

races.note: Laura Jens-Smith, the last Democrat to win the seat before Jerry Halpin, unseated incumbent Sean Walter by 649 votes (53.6% to 46.4%).

priorElectionsNote: Riverhead town general-election results from the Suffolk County Board of Elections. Totals combine each candidate's party lines (e.g. Republican + Conservative). 2026 results are unofficial and not yet certified; every other year shown is final. Supervisor-race participation ranged from about a third of registered voters to about 41%, and the 2026 vote count was the largest of any year shown.
